chunks: And so that those who have been given knowledge may know that this is the truth from your Lord, and come to believe in it, and their hearts become submissive to Him. Verily, God guides those who believe to the straight path.

key_terms.الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ: Those who have been given knowledge
key_terms.تُخْبِتَ لَهُ قُلُوبُهُمْ: Their hearts become submissive to Him
key_terms.فَيُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ: And come to believe in it

ai.seo_question: What is the role of knowledge in leading to true faith and heart submission according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the pivotal role of the 'People of Knowledge' (Ahl al-Ilm), often identified with the Imams, in verifying the authenticity of revelation and leading the faithful to sincere submission (khushu'). It connects intellectual conviction with spiritual humility, affirming that God guides the believers to the straight path through the medium of true knowledge.
